question_text: A government employee, Maria, accepted a bribe to expedite a business permit. She was charged under RA 3019 (Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act) and also administratively under RA 6713. Which of the following best distinguishes the two laws in this scenario?

options.text: RA 6713 covers ethical breaches like accepting gifts, while RA 3019 covers corrupt practices like bribery.
RA 3019 covers ethical breaches like conflict of interest, while RA 6713 covers corrupt practices like bribery.
Both laws cover the same acts, so Maria can only be charged under one.
RA 6713 only applies to appointed officials, while RA 3019 applies to all.
